payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a minimal direct landing page. Use: single column layout, maximum white space, essential content only, one CTA, clean typography, no decorative elements, fast loading, direct messaging.
payload.best_for: Simple service landing pages, indie products, consulting services, micro SaaS, freelancer portfolios
payload.css_technical_keywords: max-width: 680px, margin: 0 auto, padding: 4rem 2rem, font-size: 18-20px, line-height: 1.6, minimal animations, no box-shadow, clean borders only
payload.do_not_use_for: Feature-heavy products, complex explanations, multi-product showcases
payload.effects_and_animation: Very subtle hover effects, minimal animations, fast page load (no heavy animations), smooth scroll
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Single column centered, ☐ White space generous, ☐ One primary CTA only, ☐ No decorative images, ☐ Page weight < 500KB, ☐ Load time < 2s
payload.keywords: Minimal text, white space heavy, single column layout, direct messaging, clean typography, visual-centric, fast-loading
payload.primary_colors: Monochromatic primary, white background, single accent color for CTA, black/dark grey text
payload.secondary_colors: Minimal secondary colors, reserved for critical CTAs only, neutral supporting elements
